question: Where was the bilateral naval exercise SLINEX 24 conducted between India and Sri Lanka in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SLINEX** is a bilateral naval exercise conducted between **India and Sri Lanka** to enhance mutual cooperation and interoperability between the navies of the two countries.
 
• The **SLINEX 24** naval exercise was conducted in **Visakhapatnam**, a major port city in the state of Andhra Pradesh, India, in **December 2024**.
 
• Visakhapatnam, also known as Vizag, serves as the headquarters of the **Eastern Naval Command of the Indian Navy**, making it a strategic location for such exercises.
 
• This exercise involves complex naval drills, maritime operations, and joint tactical exercises, which help in strengthening **defense cooperation** between India and Sri Lanka.
 
• The series of SLINEX exercises aims to increase maritime security in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**, a strategically important area for both nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Visakhapatnam:**

 
 
• Located on the eastern coast of India, Visakhapatnam is one of the oldest port cities and is popularly known as the **“City of Destiny.”**
 
• It houses the headquarters of the **Eastern Naval Command** of the Indian Navy, making it a key location for naval operations and exercises.
 
• The city has a natural harbor and is a hub for various maritime activities, including shipbuilding and naval training.
 
 
 
• **SLINEX Exercises:**
 
 
• The acronym **SLINEX** stands for **Sri Lanka–India Naval Exercise**.
 
• These exercises started in **2005** and have been conducted regularly to enhance maritime cooperation and security.
 
• They include activities such as **anti-piracy operations, search and rescue drills, and communication exercises**, showcasing the operational capabilities of the navies.
 
 
 
• **Importance of India-Sri Lanka Maritime Relations:**
 
 
• The Indian Ocean Region (IOR) is geopolitically significant, with both nations relying heavily on its waters for trade and security.
 
• India and Sri Lanka share a maritime boundary, and their cooperation is essential for addressing challenges like **piracy, smuggling, and illegal fishing.**
 
• SLINEX exercises contribute to building trust and enhancing mutual understanding between the two nations.
 
 
 
• **Other Naval Exercises by India:**
 
 
• **Malabar Exercise:** A quadrilateral naval exercise involving the United States, Japan, and Australia.
 
• **VARUNA:** A bilateral exercise between India and France.
 
• **INDRA:** A joint military exercise between India and Russia.
